Mittātherīgāthā Mittā (1st) Verses of the Elder Mittā

“Saddhāya pabbajitvāna, Having gone forth in faith, “Now that you have gone forth out of faith, mitte mittaratā bhava; appreciate your spiritual friends, Mittā. Mittā, appreciate your spiritual companions. Bhāvehi kusale dhamme, Develop skillful qualities Cultivate wholesome qualities yogakkhemassa pattiyā”ti. for the sake of sanctuary from the yoke. for the attainment of safety from bondage.”

… Mittā therī …. The Elder Mittā
